# AuraLink Digital Agency — Machine-Readable Documentation
> AuraLink Digital Agency delivers Websites & E-Commerce, AI Agent Solutions, Custom Software Development, Workflow Automation, Digital Marketing, and Technical SEO.

## Core Capabilities
- Websites & E-Commerce: Landing pages, Business Websites, Dynamic Websites with CMS, E-Commerce Stores, 3D WebGL Experiences, Website Redesigns.
- AI Agent Solutions: Autonomous Voice Calling Agents, 24/7 WhatsApp API Business Agents, Social Media Manager Agents, Sales Qualification Agents, Lead Generation Agents, Onboarding & Scraping Agents.
- Custom Software Solutions: Web Applications (React/Next.js), Cross-Platform Mobile Apps (iOS/Android), SaaS Platforms, CRM Systems, Custom ERP Systems, Internal Admin Dashboards.
- Digital Marketing & SEO: Technical SEO Audits, On-Page & Local SEO, Google Business Profile Optimization, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Analytics & Event Tracking.
- Creative & Maintenance: Brand Identity, UI/UX Design, Dedicated Support Desk, Ongoing Website Maintenance.

## Multi-Currency Pricing Philosophy
- Currencies Supported: USD ($), INR (₹), EUR (€).
- USD is the primary international pricing reference.
- India utilizes localized lower regional pricing.
- Europe utilizes localized EUR pricing.
- Predefined static rates per currency; no live currency conversion math.
- Local Starter Website: INR ₹8,000 / USD $199 / EUR €179
- Business Website: INR ₹14,999 / USD $399 / EUR €349
- E-Commerce Store: INR ₹29,999 / USD $499 / EUR €449
- Premium 3D Website: INR ₹39,999 / USD $599 / EUR €549
- AI Voice Agent: INR ₹19,999 / USD $499 / EUR €449
- WhatsApp Business Agent: INR ₹14,999 / USD $399 / EUR €379
- Custom Software (Web/SaaS/CRM): Starting from INR ₹39,999 / USD $399 / EUR €379
- Enterprise ERP Systems: Quoted on a Custom Quote basis depending on module scope.
- Note: Third-party API usage (telephony minutes, Meta WhatsApp API conversation charges, hosting, AI model API usage) is separate from development fees.
